pre_registration_note: The source historical results were already observed before this plan. This plan is frozen before THIS diagnostic execution only; it is not a fresh pre-registration of the source experiment.
question: Does the active Stage1 open-action logistic model carry out-of-sample conditional information about its OWN execute_advantage label, and what is the real net contribution of the recorded active path over the true no-hold upstream and explicit SOXX references, measured separately per cost?
prior_claim_retracted: A near-zero unconditional label mean does NOT imply E[y|X]=0 and does NOT prove the label is pure noise.
An IC confidence interval crossing zero means 'no evidence found', not 'no information exists'.
The base allocation strategy_returns.csv is 2686 sessions x 2 cost_bps (unique key signal_date+cost_bps); it must not be concatenated into one equity path.
The base allocation is NOT the confidence-veto / no-hold reference and must not be presented as the direct action baseline.

frozen_sources.note: byte hashes bound before the run; a mismatched snapshot/hash or source grain BLOCKS the run rather than continuing.

windows.concatenation: none; development and outer are reported separately and never chained into one continuous account
windows.note: windows are the source full common span; no arbitrary truncation

active_open_action_logistic.prediction: each year predicted by THAT year's saved pipeline (fit only on prior data)
active_open_action_logistic.label: execute_advantage from the SAME baseline-domain rows, strictly matured
active_open_action_logistic.maturity: decision_at = signal_date+1; label_available_at = signal_date+2; terminal NaT dropped

model_identity.note: cross-account active-minus-no_hold returns are NOT the label and are withdrawn

references.no_hold_upstream: no_hold_reference (always executes the legal baseline target; does NOT use the open hold/execute action layer; not shadow, not forced-hold)
references.soxx_buy_hold: SOXX over the strategy's own trade/exit sessions, settled via settle_target_session with fees
references.soxx_cash_fixed: pre-declared 50/50 SOXX/cash rebalanced to target each session and fee-charged; no full-sample fitted matched beta

local_counterfactual.method: use the frozen 17f81fbf own-state paths directly; no refit and no reconstruction
local_counterfactual.scope: frozen recorded evidence with the source card's own reset semantics
local_counterfactual.provenance: baseline-state rows and candidate own-state rows are kept distinct; labels are never cross-assigned

cost_symmetry_check: both 10bp and 25bp come from the same frozen source; a 10bp path is never repriced to impersonate 25bp

gates.informational: report rankIC/AUC/probability calibration of the ACTIVE model's execute_probability against its OWN execute_advantage, on the decidable subset, with block bootstrap CIs
gates.contribution: report net contribution of active vs no_hold per cost, plus true-account delta and the segments where MaxDD/CVaR worsened

stopping: No model, no tuning, no threshold search. Report all results including a null result.
limitations: Diagnostic only; produces no strategy and grants no promotion.
Reused diagnostic window is not a clean holdout.
The own-state path is a one-session + next-reset proxy as recorded by its source card.
contribution_rule: per segment x cost, each variant reset from its own initialization; segments never multiplied

statistics.note: rankIC/AUC/advantage CIs computed by moving a 20-session block over the full trading-day index with eligibility preserved; point estimates on the decidable subset
